geometry_policy: Official addresses and national-grid references constrain the search area but do not constitute an exact parcel polygon. Existing rows remain NOT_BOUND until the canonical runner obtains exact building or parcel geometry evidence.

features.name: Westfield London
features.official_source_evidence: The official Westfield London page identifies the destination as a shopping centre with shops, food and drink, entertainment and centre services. It publishes the address Ariel Way, Shepherd's Bush, London W12 7SL.
features.web_source_evidence: Primary operator evidence directly supports the Retail Property classification.
features.map_source_evidence: Use the official Ariel Way W12 7SL address and centre map to bind the shopping-centre footprint. Do not treat car parks or the wider White City estate as the parcel without boundary evidence.

features.name: The News Building
features.official_source_evidence: News UK identifies its London address as 1 London Bridge Street, London SE1 9GF. The Shard's official site identifies The News Building as News UK's headquarters in Shard Quarter.
features.web_source_evidence: Primary occupier and estate evidence supports the Office Building classification.
features.map_source_evidence: Use 1 London Bridge Street SE1 9GF and the Shard Quarter plan to isolate The News Building footprint; do not bind The Shard or London Bridge station footprint.

features.name: The Shard
features.official_source_evidence: The official Shard site describes a vertical city containing offices, residences, restaurants, a hotel, viewing gallery and public spaces.
features.web_source_evidence: Primary building-operator evidence directly supports the Mixed Building classification.
features.map_source_evidence: Use the official Shard Quarter plan and London Bridge address context to isolate The Shard tower footprint. The adjacent News Building and station must remain separate.

features.name: One Hyde Park
features.official_source_evidence: Authoritative current reporting identifies One Hyde Park as a luxury residential development in Knightsbridge. Published building records give the address as 100 Knightsbridge, London SW1X 7LJ.
features.web_source_evidence: Authoritative property reporting and consistent building records support the Apartment Building classification; a current public operator page was not relied upon.
features.map_source_evidence: Use the 100 Knightsbridge SW1X 7LJ address to isolate the four-block residential complex. The adjacent Mandarin Oriental hotel must not be included without boundary evidence.

features.name: Witanhurst
features.official_source_evidence: Historic England list entry 1379026 identifies Witanhurst as a Grade II* substantial detached house at 41 Highgate West Hill and provides National Grid Reference TQ 28117 87189.
features.web_source_evidence: The statutory national heritage record directly supports the Detached Home classification and exact property identity.
features.map_source_evidence: Use the statutory address and NGR only to locate the building. Bind the principal house footprint separately from the wider grounds, gatehouse and later extensions.

features.name: SEGRO Park Dagenham / London Sustainable Industries Park
features.official_source_evidence: SEGRO's property-search identity and published public-sector records identify SEGRO Park Dagenham within the London Sustainable Industries Park at Dagenham Dock.
features.web_source_evidence: Primary property-company identity plus public planning context supports an industrial/logistics classification, but the estate contains multiple units.
features.map_source_evidence: A specific occupied or marketed unit must be selected and bound. Do not use the entire sustainable-industries park as a single Industrial Unit geometry.
